tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon probe shows reversal near H=8.61 and increasingly negative responses through H=24.6, consistent with a fast positive and slower negative exponential response. Fit all four parameters numerically and test on fresh observations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are zero, leaving its sink coefficient unidentified; the simpler recalled dual-exponential mechanism matches the observed short- and long-horizon pattern.
The observed sustained long-horizon reversal and positive short-horizon response support the recalled adaptation mechanism over an oscillatory alternative.
The existing eight observations span short and slow horizons and constrain the four-parameter candidate; fresh confirmation is the appropriate next test.
